findings.title: The University of Maryland, Baltimore (UMB) did not independently review for propriety changes to student residency status that significantly impacted tuition rates.
findings.description: UMB did not independently review for propriety changes to student residency status that significantly impacted tuition rates. Reviews performed prior to July 2020 were not independent since the reports were generated by an employee who made changes rather than directly obtained from the system by the reviewer. Consequently, UMB lacked assurance that all student residency changes made were appropriate.

dollar_amounts.context: annual tuition charge difference for Doctor of Dental Surgery program between Maryland residents and non-residents

findings.recommendation: UMB should review output reports of changes made to student residency for propriety at least on a test basis; ensure that such reviews are documented; and ensure that the employee responsible for generating the output reports and performing the reviews does not have system access capabilities to make residency status changes to student accounts.

findings.title: Reviews performed by UMB for ensuring the propriety of certain financial aid award adjustments were not independent, sufficiently comprehensive, and were not documented.
findings.description: Reviews performed by UMB for ensuring the propriety of certain financial aid award adjustments were not independent, sufficiently comprehensive, and were not documented. A review of 12 material award adjustments disclosed a lack of documentation that the review by schools was performed for each adjustment. Employees responsible for verification were the same employees who submitted the adjustment request.

dollar_amounts.context: award adjustments requested by the various academic schools within UMB during fiscal 2021
material award adjustments totaling reviewed for documentation of school verification

findings.recommendation: UMB should ensure, at least on a test basis, that financial aid award adjustments requested by the academic schools are independently verified using independently generated output reports of all recorded adjustments, and that these verifications be documented.

findings.title: UMB did not refer certain delinquent grant receivable balances to the State's Central Collection Unit as required.
findings.description: UMB did not refer certain delinquent grant receivable balances to the State's Central Collection Unit (CCU) as required. As of August 2021, grants receivables totaled $59.6 million, of which $11.8 million was more than 180 days past due. A review disclosed six accounts totaling $425,694 were outstanding for between 377 and 833 days and had not been forwarded to CCU.

dollar_amounts.context: grants receivables total as of August 2021
grants receivables more than 180 days past due as of August 2021
portion of delinquent grants receivable due from non-State entities
material receivables from non-State agencies outstanding for more than 180 days reviewed
outstanding accounts not forwarded to CCU

findings.recommendation: UMB should refer delinquent grant receivable balances to CCU in accordance with CCU regulations, as amended for UMB.

findings.title: UMB did not perform documented independent verifications that collections received by university departments were forwarded to the Cashier's Office for deposit.
findings.description: UMB did not perform documented independent verifications that collections received by university departments were forwarded to the Cashier's Office for deposit. For 4 of the departments tested, there was no documentation that the department had verified that 12 of the collections totaling $18.4 million had been forwarded to the Office for deposit.

dollar_amounts.context: material collections received directly by 5 UMB departments during the period from January 2020 to July 2021
collections totaling for which there was no documentation that they had been forwarded to the Office for deposit
UMB departments collected during fiscal year 2021
collections at the aforementioned 4 departments during fiscal year 2021

findings.recommendation: UMB should ensure that an independent and documented verification of collections received to collections forwarded for deposit is performed by all university departments.

findings.title: UMB did not adequately document the review of adjustments to leave balances recorded in UMB's payroll system, resulting in a lack of assurance that all recorded adjustments were valid.
findings.description: UMB did not adequately document the review of adjustments to leave balances (including annual, sick, and personal leave) recorded in UMB's payroll system. Our test of eight material leave adjustments disclosed that UMB was unable to provide adequate documentation to support a review of those adjustments by the respective schools.
findings.recommendation: UMB should ensure that leave adjustments processed in its payroll system are reviewed, at least on a test basis, by its respective schools for propriety by independent supervisory personnel and that this review be adequately documented.
